meta.name: azure-messaging
meta.description: Troubleshoot and resolve issues with Azure Messaging SDKs for Event Hubs and Service Bus. Covers connection failures, authentication errors, message processing issues, and SDK configuration problems. WHEN: event hub SDK error, service bus SDK issue, messaging connection failure, AMQP error, event processor host issue, message lock lost, message lock expired, lock renewal, lock renewal batch, send timeout, receiver disconnected, SDK troubleshooting, azure messaging SDK, event hub consumer, service bus queue issue, topic subscription error, enable logging event hub, service bus logging, eventhub python, servicebus java, eventhub javascript, servicebus dotnet, event hub checkpoint, event hub not receiving messages, service bus dead letter, batch processing lock, session lock expired, idle timeout, connection inactive, link detach, slow reconnect, session error, duplicate events, offset reset, receive batch.

copy.tagline: 排查 Azure 消息服务 SDK 的各类问题
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're using Azure Event Hubs or Service Bus and facing SDK issues.

howto.what: 装了这个技能后，Claude 能诊断和解决 Azure Event Hubs 与 Service Bus 的 SDK 问题，比如连接失败、认证错误、锁丢失、超时等。
howto.when: 当你报告 Azure 消息服务 SDK 报错或异常时触发，例如连接失败、锁过期、会话错误等。

say.text: 我的 Event Hubs 连接一直超时。
say.note: 它会检查连接字符串和网络配置。

say.text: Service Bus 消息锁丢失了。
say.note: 它会分析锁超时原因并给出重试建议。

say.text: Python 的 Event Hubs SDK 报 AMQP 错误。
say.note: 它会查找文档并给出 SDK 配置调整。

howto.what_en: After installing this skill, Claude can diagnose and resolve issues with Azure Event Hubs and Service Bus SDKs, including connection failures, authentication errors, lock loss, and timeouts.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you report SDK errors or exceptions in Azure messaging services, such as connection failures, lock expiration, or session errors.

say_en.text: My Event Hubs connection keeps timing out.
say_en.note: It will check the connection string and network configuration.
It will analyze lock timeout reasons and recommend retries.

say_en.text: Python Event Hubs SDK AMQP error.
say_en.note: It will search documentation and suggest SDK config adjustments.
